newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks unaffected by U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: French stocks unaffected by U.S. data.

text.p: French stocks were barely affected and still in positive territory after U.S. economic data came in close to expectations.

The blue-chip CAC-40 index was up 6.91 points or 0.31 percent at 2,224.10 at shortly after the release of U.S. consumer prices and retail sales data for October compared to 2,224.42 just before the data.
The CAC-40 November futures contract was down at four points at 2,229.0.
